name: frihet-workspace
description: Onboard, orient, and review a connected Frihet workspace, daily operational priorities, month-over-month period comparisons, and the product and service catalogue in ChatGPT. Use after installing the plugin (onboarding and setup), when the user asks what deserves attention today, compares monthly business periods, requests a workspace overview, checks plan usage or defaults, or lists, inspects, creates, or updates catalogue products and services.
